about_the_game:
Dates never end up how you expected when you're a witch dating a boy from the future.

But now that it's their first anniversary, the fate of their relationship is on the line! David must craft the perfect date for Henry— with no magical or futuristic hijinks! It may take help from an immortal spirit of love and some time loop shenanigans to get it just right...

Discover a variety of endings full of peculiar characters and even peculiar-er situations, where action scenes may shift the course of the date altogether! From fighting trickster god at a dessert cafe to unleashing a bloodthirsty virtual pet at the city park, you never know how the day is going to end!

This visual novel is part of the webcomic "Warp Speed and Witchcraft", but you do not need to be familiar with the series to enjoy this game!

Features

  • A multitude of humorous endings to discover, with an overarching story featuring themes of queer self-acceptance and love

  • A variety of minigames that will keep you on your toes

  • An option for Story Mode if you are less interested in the challenge of minigames

  • Cute hand-drawn art and funky music by a variety of composers
